name: JW Marriott Tampa Water Street
positioning: Luxury downtown hotel on Tampa's Riverwalk in the Water Street district, with a sixth-floor rooftop pool deck and spa
best_for: Travelers who want a walkable downtown Tampa base by the Riverwalk
Guests heading to a game or concert at Benchmark International Arena

facts.text: The hotel is in Tampa's Water Street district, near Benchmark International Arena, the Florida Aquarium and the Straz Center for the Performing Arts.
Benchmark International Arena, for hockey games and concerts, is adjacent to the hotel.
Guest rooms have expansive windows and look out over the waterfront and the Water Street neighborhood.
Connecting rooms and suites can be arranged to give families more space.
Private cabanas on the pool deck can be rented for the day.
Driftlight Steakhouse serves fine-aged steaks and locally sourced seafood.
Curated picnic baskets for two to four guests can be enjoyed along the waterfront, aboard a private sail or in your room.
The fitness center is open 24 hours.
The hotel offers nearly 100,000 square feet of event space.
The Executive Lounge is on the fifth floor.

highlights.text: The sixth floor has a rooftop pool deck with two pools and views of Tampa Bay.
Spa by JW has 10 treatment rooms, a relaxation lounge and a rooftop whirlpool spa.
Beacon, on the 27th floor, is a rooftop cocktail bar with panoramic views of the city skyline and waterfront.
The hotel sits on Tampa's Riverwalk in the downtown district.
Guests arrive to an herbaceous, uplifting scent from JW Marriott's partnership with Flamingo Estate.

considerations.text: The hotel charges a destination fee.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
